nodes.label: Just vs Unjust Law
nodes.source_file: src/routes/blog/posts/Review of King's Letter from Birmingham Jail.md
nodes.rationale: King advances seven propositions splitting into theological (law out of harmony with eternal/natural law; sin as separation) and philosophical (uplifts vs degrades personality; I-it vs I-thou; sameness made legal; franchise; congruence with founding myth). The white moderate devoted to order is a bigger obstacle than the Klan.
